## Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)

source(here("Kalman filtering", "ssm_functions.R"))
dir.create(here("output", "state_space_figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load the data and Stage 1 results

```{r}
results_sa  <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "local_level_sa_results.rds"))
y           <- results_sa$pi_sa
fit_sa      <- StructTS(ts(y, start = c(2010, 3), frequency = 12), type = "level")
resid_check <- y - results_sa$smoothed
```

## Fat-tailed noise: draw each month's multiplier

```{r}
sample_lambda <- function(resid, noise_var, nu) {
  shape <- (nu + 1) / 2
  rate  <- (nu + resid^2 / noise_var) / 2
  1 / rgamma(length(resid), shape = shape, rate = rate)
}
```

## Test: which months does the fat-tailed model flag as extreme?

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
lambda_check <- replicate(2000, sample_lambda(resid_check,
                                              noise_var = fit_sa$coef["epsilon"],
                                              nu = 5))

tibble(date = results_sa$date, lambda = apply(lambda_check, 1, median)) |>
  arrange(desc(lambda)) |>
  head(8)
```

## Fat-tailed noise: draw nu (how common extreme months are)

```{r}
sample_nu <- function(lambda, nu_grid = c(seq(2.1, 10, by = 0.1), 11:60)) {
  logpost <- sapply(nu_grid, function(nu)
    sum(dgamma(1 / lambda, shape = nu / 2, rate = nu / 2, log = TRUE) - 2 * log(lambda)))
  sample(nu_grid, 1, prob = exp(logpost - max(logpost)))
}
```

## Test: does sample_nu recover a known nu?

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
lambda_sim <- 1 / rgamma(197, shape = 4 / 2, rate = 4 / 2)   # true nu = 4
nu_check   <- replicate(2000, sample_nu(lambda_sim))
quantile(nu_check, c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
```

## Fat-tailed model: Gibbs sampler

```{r}
run_fat_tails <- function(y, sig2_eta_start, sig2_eps_start,
                          n_burn = 5000, n_keep = 10000, thin = 5, seed = 2026,
                          a0 = 2, b0 = 1) {
  n        <- length(y)
  sig2_eta <- sig2_eta_start   # baseline noise variance
  sig2_eps <- sig2_eps_start   # trend step variance
  lambda   <- rep(1, n)        # monthly multipliers, start at "normal"
  nu       <- 10               # start with moderate tails

  tau_draws    <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n)
  lambda_draws <- matrix(NA, n_keep, n)
  par_draws    <- matrix(NA, n_keep, 3,
                         dimnames = list(NULL, c("sig2_eta", "sig2_eps", "nu")))

  set.seed(seed)
  for (i in 1:(n_burn + n_keep * thin)) {
    tau      <- sample_local_level(y, obs_var = sig2_eta * lambda, step_var = sig2_eps,
                                   init_mean = y[1], init_var = 1e6)
    e        <- y - tau
    lambda   <- sample_lambda(e, sig2_eta, nu)
    sig2_eta <- 1 / rgamma(1, a0 + n / 2,       b0 + sum(e^2 / lambda) / 2)
    sig2_eps <- 1 / rgamma(1, a0 + (n - 1) / 2, b0 + sum(diff(tau)^2) / 2)
    nu       <- sample_nu(lambda)

    if (i > n_burn && (i - n_burn) %% thin == 0) {
      k <- (i - n_burn) / thin
      tau_draws[k, ]    <- tau
      lambda_draws[k, ] <- lambda
      par_draws[k, ]    <- c(sig2_eta, sig2_eps, nu)
    }
    if (i %% 10000 == 0) message("iteration ", i)
  }
  list(tau = tau_draws, lambda = lambda_draws, par = par_draws)
}
```

## Run the fat-tailed model

```{r, cache=TRUE}
ft <- run_fat_tails(y, sig2_eta_start = unname(fit_sa$coef["epsilon"]),
                       sig2_eps_start = unname(fit_sa$coef["level"]))

par_summary <- apply(cbind(sd_noise = sqrt(ft$par[, "sig2_eta"]),
                           sd_step  = sqrt(ft$par[, "sig2_eps"]),
                           nu       = ft$par[, "nu"]),
                     2, quantile, c(0.05, 0.50, 0.95))
par_summary

coda::effectiveSize(coda::mcmc(ft$par))
summary(coda::effectiveSize(coda::mcmc(ft$tau)))
```

## Summarize and compare with Stage 1 and UC-SV (smoothed)

```{r}
q <- function(draws, p) apply(draws, 2, quantile, p)

ft_results <- tibble(
  date    = results_sa$date,
  pi_sa   = y,
  tau_med = q(ft$tau, 0.50),
  tau_lo  = q(ft$tau, 0.05),
  tau_hi  = q(ft$tau, 0.95),
  lambda  = q(ft$lambda, 0.50)
)
saveRDS(ft_results, here("data", "state_space", "fat_tails_results.rds"))

ucsv <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "ucsv_results.rds"))

compare_models <- ft_results |>
  select(date, pi_sa, fat_tails = tau_med) |>
  left_join(select(ucsv, date, ucsv = tau_med), by = "date") |>
  mutate(stage1 = results_sa$smoothed)

p_models <- compare_models |>
  pivot_longer(c(stage1, ucsv, fat_tails)) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pi_sa), colour = "grey80") +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Annualized inflation (%)", colour = NULL)
p_models
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "trend_three_models.png"),
       p_models, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Which months does the model treat as extreme?

```{r}
p_lambda <- ggplot(ft_results, aes(date, lambda)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Noise variance multiplier (median)")
p_lambda
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "fat_tails_multipliers.png"),

```

## Real-time fat-tailed trend: particle filter

```{r}
ft_filter <- function(y, sig2_eta, sig2_eps, nu, n_particles = 20000, seed = 2026) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(y); N <- n_particles
  m <- rep(y[1], N)      # each world's trend estimate
  P <- rep(1e6, N)       # each world's uncertainty about it

  out <- tibble(tau_med = NA_real_, tau_lo = NA_real_, tau_hi = NA_real_, .rows = n)

  for (t in 1:n) {
    if (t > 1) P <- P + sig2_eps                             # trend takes one step
    lambda <- 1 / rgamma(N, shape = nu / 2, rate = nu / 2)   # fresh multiplier per world
    S      <- P + sig2_eta * lambda
    logw   <- dnorm(y[t], m, sqrt(S), log = TRUE)            # score each world
    w      <- exp(logw - max(logw)); w <- w / sum(w)

    K <- P / S                                               # Kalman update per world
    m <- m + K * (y[t] - m)
    P <- (1 - K) * P

    idx <- sample.int(N, N, replace = TRUE, prob = w)        # resample
    m <- m[idx]; P <- P[idx]

    tau_samples    <- rnorm(N, m, sqrt(P))
    out$tau_med[t] <- median(tau_samples)
    out$tau_lo[t]  <- quantile(tau_samples, 0.05)
    out$tau_hi[t]  <- quantile(tau_samples, 0.95)
  }
  out
}
```

## Run the real-time filter and check the final month

```{r}
par_med <- apply(ft$par, 2, median)

ft_rt <- ft_filter(y, sig2_eta = par_med["sig2_eta"],
                      sig2_eps = par_med["sig2_eps"],
                      nu       = par_med["nu"]) |>
  mutate(date = results_sa$date, .before = 1)

saveRDS(ft_rt, here("data", "state_space", "fat_tails_realtime.rds"))

c(filter_final = tail(ft_rt$tau_med, 1), mcmc_final = tail(ft_results$tau_med, 1))
```

## Compare all real-time measures: headline, Mongolbank core, Stage 1, UC-SV, fat tails

```{r}
comparison_ucsv <- readRDS(here("data", "state_space", "comparison_yoy_ucsv.rds"))

ft_rt_yoy <- ft_rt |>
  transmute(date,
            fat_tails_yoy = 100 * (exp(zoo::rollmeanr(tau_med, 12, fill = NA) / 100) - 1))

comparison_all <- comparison_ucsv |>
  left_join(ft_rt_yoy, by = "date")

saveRDS(comparison_all, here("data", "state_space", "comparison_yoy_all.rds"))

p_compare_all <- comparison_all |>
  filter(date >= ymd("2023-01-01")) |>
  pivot_longer(-date) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Year-over-year inflation (%)", colour = NULL)
p_compare_all
ggsave(here("output", "state_space_figures", "all_measures_2023_2026.png"),
       p_compare_all, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

comparison_all |> filter(date >= ymd("2026-01-01"))
```
